name: legitimate-password-reset
description: False-positive resistance: a genuine password reset from PayPal's real domain, linking only to PayPal. Contains every keyword a phish contains, so it must be separated by sender alignment, not by wording.

email.subject: You asked to reset your PayPal password
email.bodyText:
Hello Sam Okafor,

You recently asked to reset the password for the PayPal account ending in 4471. Use the link below to choose a new one. It expires in 60 minutes for your security.

Reset your password

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email — your password will not change. If you're concerned that someone else may be trying to access your account, you can review recent activity in your account settings.

We will never ask you for your password, and we will never ask you to confirm your details by replying to an email.

Thanks,
PayPal
